heading: Establishment of Committee on Nonproliferation Assistance

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The President shall establish a mechanism to coordinate, with the maximum possible effectiveness and efficiency, the efforts of United States Government departments and agencies engaged in formulating policy and carrying out programs for achieving nonproliferation and threat reduction.

tree.heading: Membership
tree.text: The coordination mechanism established pursuant to subsection (a) shall include—

children.text: the Director of the Office of Homeland Security, or the head of a successor department or agency; and
such other executive branch officials as the President may select.

tree.heading: Level of representation
tree.text: To the maximum extent possible, each department 1 or agency’s representative designated pursuant to subsection (b)(1) shall be an official of that department or agency who has been appointed by the President with the advice and consent of the Senate.

tree.heading: Chair
tree.text: The President shall designate an official to direct the coordination mechanism established pursuant to subsection (a). The official so designated may invite the head of any other department or agency of the United States to designate a representative of that department or agency to participate from time to time in the activities of the Committee.

SHORT TITLE.“This subtitle may be cited as the ‘Russian Federation Debt for Nonproliferation Act of 2002’. “SEC. 1312.
